cpcb_says: State Pollution Control Boards and Pollution Control Committees send annual reports; CPCB compiles them (36 SPCBs/PCCs).
mohua_says: Cities and States report on the Swachhatam portal (MIS); MoHUA compiles them. Q3198 annexure source line: 'Reports by ULBs on Swachhatam Portal, of MoHUA'.
why_it_matters: Two different reporting chains feed two different national totals, so a gap is expected unless both chains use the same definitions and cut-off dates.
sources: cpcb_2022-23.pdf p.5; ls_au3198_2023-12-21.docx annexure; mohua_81pct_answer.pdf p.4

cpcb_says: Table 1 column is 'Treated' (2022-23) or 'Processed/Treated' (2021-22). The report defines processing as a scientific process on segregated waste for reuse, recycling or transformation, and treatment as a method that modifies waste to reduce volume and harm.
mohua_says: Column is 'Total Waste Processed' (Q2433) or 'Waste Processed' (Q3198). The documents we hold do not define the term.
why_it_matters: We store MoHUA 'processed' as 'treated' to compare. That is an assumption of ours, not a stated equivalence, and the app must say so wherever the two are shown together.
sources: cpcb_2022-23.pdf p.5-6; cpcb_2021-22.pdf p.6; mohua_81pct_answer.pdf p.3; ls_au3198_2023-12-21.docx annexure

cpcb_says: Sanitary landfill only; disposal in open dumpsites is not included (2021-22 footnote).
mohua_says: No landfilled column in any MoHUA table we hold.
why_it_matters: CPCB leaves dumpsite disposal out of both 'treated' and 'landfilled', so it shows up as the unaccounted 'gap'. MoHUA's single processed percentage cannot show this.

cpcb_says: Generated minus treated minus sanitary-landfilled (28,576 tpd, 17%, in 2022-23). A state can show a negative gap when it adds the previous year's backlog (Chandigarh 2021-22 footnote).
why_it_matters: The CPCB 'gap' is the part of the waste with no recognised disposal route. It is the clearest reason the national treated share sits near 62% while MoHUA reports about 81%.

cpcb_says: Reported for almost every state (a few blanks, for example Bihar).
mohua_says: Not reported in the state tables we hold. MoHUA gives door-to-door collection as a ward statistic (97% in the Annual Report 2025-26).
why_it_matters: Collection is not comparable between the two: CPCB gives tonnes, MoHUA gives a share of wards.

cpcb_says: Financial year (2023-24 is April 2023 to March 2024).
mohua_says: 2025-26 for Q2433. Q3198 says only 'as on date' (21 Dec 2023) with no financial year. Q682 and Q855 give national totals without naming a financial year in the table.
why_it_matters: CPCB 2023-24 and MoHUA 2025-26 are different years, and Q3198 cannot be matched to any financial year, so no true same-year comparison exists in our data.

cpcb_says: Sum of SPCB/PCC-reported generation (170,939 tpd in 2022-23; 185,195 in 2023-24).
mohua_says: Total waste generated in urban areas as reported on the portal (161,163 to 162,372 tpd across 2024-25 and 2025-26).
why_it_matters: The percentage treated depends on the denominator. A smaller MoHUA denominator raises the percentage even if tonnes treated were equal.
sources: cpcb_2022-23.pdf p.5; ls_au50_2025-12-01.pdf p.1; mohua_state_answer.pdf p.2; mohua_81pct_answer.pdf p.3
